Beck/ Call in hand.
You have a way to draw a card, an additional creature in hand to cast, or an additional {4}{W}{U}.
description:
Activate Words of Wilding.
Cast Beck, fusing it if you have the mana available, otherwise using some other way to draw a card.
Instead of drawing a card, create a 2/2 bear token.
Beck triggers.
Sacrifice the bear to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.Allow Mana Echoes to resolve, adding {C} for each bear you control.
Before Beck's trigger resolves, activate Words of Wilding, replacing your next draw with the creation of a 2/2 bear.
Repeat for infinite colorless mana, then repeat without sacrificing the bears for infinite bears.
